decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Within three months of the date of this permission, details shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval of the height, spread, type and character of the proposed trees and a schedule of the type of shrubs proposed.  All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details within three months of such approval or in accordance with such other programme as shall first be submitted to and agreed with the local planning authority.  Any of the trees or shrubs that die within five years of their installation shall be replaced in the first available planting season thereafter.

Condition : 4 - The drainage scheme hereby approved as shown in Amended plan 02 A received 6th January 2010 shall be implemented as approved within one year of this consent and permanently retained thereafter.
description: Retention of concrete hardstanding parking area  together with use of land to the rear of 51 Beech Avenue as car parking in association with the adjoining place of worship with associated landscaping
